description.zh: 像素风横版跳跃游戏。踩扁小怪、顶出金币、躲开陷阱，一路跑到旗杆终点。共六个关卡：草原起步、管道迷宫、断崖飞跃、阶梯王国、浮空回廊、终局冲刺，通关后自动解锁下一关，也可以从主菜单直接选关。支持键盘与触屏操作，自动保存最高分与解锁进度。
description.en: A pixel-art side-scrolling platformer. Stomp enemies, bump blocks, dodge pits and race to the flagpole. Six stages — Meadow Start, Pipe Maze, Canyon Leap, Stair Kingdom, Sky Gallery and Final Rush — each unlocking the next on completion, with stage select from the title screen. Keyboard & touch controls, best score and progress auto-saved.

controls.zh: ←→/AD 移动，空格/↑/W 跳跃，Esc/P 暂停；触屏设备提供屏幕按钮；主菜单可点数字选关，通关面板点「下一关」继续
controls.en: Arrows/A-D to move, Space/Up/W to jump, Esc/P to pause; on-screen buttons on touch devices; pick a stage from the numbered buttons on the title screen, then Next level on the clear screen
